notes.title: Release Date Announced - October 28th!
notes.notes:
Fellow Horror Fans,

Let's make it short: Massacre At The Mirage will be released on October 28th already! What a great way to start into Spooktober.

Watch the Release Date Announcement trailer here:

[previewyoutube=wewLqE_WQOY;full][/previewyoutube]

Make sure to keep an eye on the announcement section, especially with the Steam Next Fest coming up very soon. And don't forget to get your (Wishlist) cinema ticket to not miss the new Demo as well as getting notified at the game's release.

Can't wait for you to play and step into Manny's Cinema of Madness. ːsteammockingː

Talk to you soon!
